query:
SELECT u.id,
                COALESCE(u.email, '') AS "email!",
                u.name,
                u.platform_role::text AS "platform_role!"
         FROM oauth_accounts oa
         JOIN users u
           ON u.id = oa.user_id
         WHERE oa.provider = ($1::text)::oauth_provider
           AND oa.provider_tenant_id = $2
           AND oa.provider_object_id = $3
         LIMIT 1
